title: Native addon uses the wrong Node module ABI
summary: A pre-existing native addon layer was compiled for a different NODE_MODULE_VERSION than the active Node runtime.

proof_eligibility.reason: The planned case changes one typed dimension inside the supported Linux isolation backend.

oracle.description: The unchanged fixture assertion exits zero and emits the DEV-NATIVE-001 success marker.

scenario.failure_mode: The default content-addressed addon was compiled against Node 24 module ABI 137, so Node 22 module ABI 127 rejects it with Node's NODE_MODULE_VERSION mismatch diagnostic.
planned_setup: Provide two content-addressed Linux x64 glibc addon layers compiled from the same source.
Keep the fixed Node 22 runtime, loader assertion, source, compiler flags, and dependencies identical.
Select the ABI-137 layer in A1 and A2; select the ABI-127 layer only in B.
